title: LRU Cache Implementation
instruction: Implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache in Python as a class LRUCache(capacity). It should support get(key) and put(key, value) operations, both in O(1) average time. When the cache exceeds capacity, evict the least recently used item.
expected_behavior: A class using OrderedDict or a doubly-linked list + hash map that provides O(1) get and put with correct LRU eviction.
evaluation_criteria: Class is named LRUCache with capacity parameter
get(key) returns value or -1 if not found
Evicts least recently used item when over capacity
get() marks item as recently used
put() on existing key marks it as recently used
